text: Ko onon yo gomɗimɓe Alla e Nulaaɗo Makko, wata o bonnititr barjaari sadaqaaji mon ɗin wajitugol lorra rokkaaɗo on.Sabu on ittiroowo sadaqa fii wajitugol yiinoo e yimɓe, ko o yedduɗo Alla e Ñalaande Darngal, yeddi neema e lepte maggal.On ɗon no wa'i wa fetere=haayre nde mbullaari woni e dow mum, toɓo heewngo ara nde; ɗam acca nde e ɓowru.Ko wano non kadi yiinitooɓe ɓen; baraaji sadaqaaji maɓɓe ɗin yehay, huunde heddotaako e majji. Alla Fewnataa heeferɓe ɓen e kon ko O Welaa O Toowi e ko nafatabe e golle e nafakeeji maɓɓe.
